_comment: A curated profile document; docs/PROFILE.md explains each key.
denylist, input_sensitivity, busy_indicator and safe_controls are
policy and measurement a person writes. `ghostdriver check-profile`
reads one back and says what the tool will make of it.
Which targets may be driven is not in here: that is decided at
attach, by the person, for the life of the target process (R1, R1a).

input_sensitivity.evidence: hosted web content counts input events; machine-speed typing is rejected without a visible error
the native shell does not inspect input timing

safe_controls.note: expands the instruction blocks; nothing is committed
